Elaine (Partnerships): Heads-up — marketplace MDF showing ~30% short vs our QBR plan. Need to reconcile committed co-marketing + partner scorecards by EOD Thu. @Samir can you pull partner-tier spend vs activation?

Samir (Sales Ops): Posted quick export (top partners). CSV snippet: CloudCo | Gold | committed 12k | spent 8k | listings 2 | leads 43; InfraSys | Silver | 8k | 7k | listings 1 | leads 9; EdgeWorks | Bronze | 5k | 5k | listings 0 | leads 1. Full sheet uploaded.

Jake (Finance): Reminder: any MDF reallocation must be entered in the QBR workbook by COB Fri with an ROI note.

Zoe (Comms): If we pause co-marketing for anyone with a joint announcement, comms must be locked now. Who's in the announcement pipeline?

Elaine (Partnerships): Pipeline: CloudCo (ref-arch launch), EdgeWorks (hardware bundle), InfraSys (SI integration). EdgeWorks has zero activations — likely freeze candidate.

dev-rel-bot: Marketplace conversion dashboard refreshed — https://redwood.example.com/marketplace/dashboards/conversion (2026-03-10 09:12 UTC)

Samir (Sales Ops): Applied ROI>2x filter. Keep CloudCo and InfraSys. EdgeWorks flagged for pause.

Elaine (Partnerships): Action proposal: 1) Freeze EdgeWorks MDF for marketplace until they submit an activation plan (due Mon). 2) Reallocate $6k from EdgeWorks -> CloudCo for banner + webinar. 3) Jake to approve reallocation in workbook. 4) Zoe to draft contingency comms. 5) Samir to update scorecards.

Jake (Finance): I can approve conditionally if Samir adds expected incremental pipeline and confidence level for CloudCo in the workbook. Tag me when done.

Samir (Sales Ops): Added: expected incremental pipeline = $90k (3mo outlook), confidence = medium. Workbook row linked and tagged Jake.

Maria (Go-to-Market): I'll draft a 1-page partner playbook with 3 tactical steps to accelerate listing activation by Wed.

Zoe (Comms): Drafting neutral pause blurb: "marketing support will be rescheduled pending certification milestones" — will post in #marketing for review.

Elaine (Partnerships): Consensus? Proceed with freeze + conditional reallocation on Jake sign-off. :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:
